description: Returns today's checked items from the Context Pill feed (releases, tools, techniques). Each item has a verification status, a source trust score, evidence links, why it matters and an optional try-this step. The optional topic parameter filters by a word such as 'claude', 'codex' or 'open weights'. Fits questions about what's new in AI, recent models, tools, features, pricing or benchmarks.

limit.description: Number of items to return, 1 to 30. Default 15.

topic.description: Optional word to filter by, such as a vendor, product or model name. Leave empty for all of today's checked items, up to the limit.

name: get_latest
title: Today's Context Pill drop
